title: Embracing Contradiction: Theoretical Inconsistency Will Not Impede the Road of Building Responsible AI Systems
reasoning: The paper is a position piece centered on the ethical and epistemological foundations of Responsible AI. It explicitly draws on moral philosophy (e.g., Isaiah Berlin, John Rawls, Joseph Raz) and value pluralism to argue that inconsistent metrics capture multifaceted ethical concepts, making ethics and moral theory a central component of its argument rather than a side consideration.
